# Self-Declared Token / Decentralized Partnership Agreement research experiment

This is a non-audited synthetic-only research prototype. Local contract tests, not an identity service or legal conclusion. Public unsalted SHA256 digest can be guessed; passport and bank identifiers are unverified self-assertions. No real identity data, transactions, fees, or production use.

Build: `npm ci && npm run compile && npm test && npm run build` in the project root. Reproduce scenario: `npx hardhat run scripts/run-scenario.ts` generates local JSON, ABIs and CSV under `artifacts/research/<timestamp>/`. Static web root `dist`; Vercel root repository root, build command `npm run compile && npm run build`, output `dist`, install `npm ci`. UI reads generated ABI and bytecode; wallet signing is only through injected browser wallet. UI accepts only chain 84532 Base Sepolia or local 31337. The current synthetic Base Sepolia NFT package pilot receipts and manifest are under `docs/evidence/base-sepolia/nft-package-pilot/`. Earlier SDT/DPA and ERC-1155 pilot evidence was removed from the current repository tree; Git history and chain records remain. This does not imply resolution of outstanding security or export issues.

Identity serialization: SHA256(UTF8(full_name + '|' + DD.MM.YYYY + '|' + passport_number + '|' + bank_transaction_id)); no salt, trimming, normalization or wallet field. SDT is ERC-721 non-transferable ERC-5192-compatible. Holder burns; immutable issuer, hash and issuance block survive. DPA hardcodes one trusted SDT and agreement-version hash, supports EOA EIP-712 SDT acceptance only, with domain chain and verifying contract binding, typed wallet/hash/SDT/token/identity/nonce, on-chain holder verification, nonce consumption and surviving acceptance snapshot. Agreement text is synthetic and off chain, kept in client source. A signature may be relayed by others. Pre-authenticated identification mode and contract wallets are not implemented. No bank oracle or payments.

Independent full spec: `docs/specification.md`. Threats: `docs/threat-model.md`. Test coverage: `docs/test-matrix.md`. Current NFT evidence: `docs/evidence/base-sepolia/nft-package-pilot/manifest.json`. Source research rights remain with the author; no license is granted here. Contract source identifies SPDX UNLICENSED.
